update.title: Fixed Docklike hover previews and capture throttling
update.summary: Introduced a dedicated hover state machine and fair capture scheduling so preview menus close cleanly and every visible window keeps receiving live thumbnail updates.

preview.description: A stable hover state keeps the window popup open while fair capture scheduling refreshes every visible preview.

blocks.body:
## Make hover behavior explicit

I introduced a dedicated `HoverManager` to coordinate the panel button, preview popup, and menu items. It moves through closed, opening, open, and grace-period states. Pointer movement feeds the state machine, keeping the menu available while moving into it and clearing the hover style when the interaction ends.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Enter[Pointer enters] --> Open[Show preview]
  Leave[Pointer leaves button] --> Grace[Keep menu open briefly]
  Grace -->|Pointer enters menu| Open
  Grace -->|Timeout| Close[Clear state and hide]
  Open --> Queue{Capture queue busy?}
  Queue -->|No| All[Refresh all windows]
  Queue -->|Yes| Rotate[Round-robin refresh]
blocks.description: One coordinator owns the handoff between the panel and preview menu, then adapts live refresh scheduling to capture load.

blocks.body:
## Share capture time fairly

Live refresh requests use queue depth to decide how captures are admitted. At normal load, every visible window can request a fresh thumbnail; when the queue becomes busy, round-robin selection rotates the next accepted request between windows.
